faqs.q: Do I need a separate page for each city I serve in Quebec?
faqs.a: If you genuinely serve more than one city and can describe each one distinctly, separate pages help, because people search with a city name attached. Copied pages that only swap the place name tend to hurt more than help.

faqs.q: How long does it take to rank in Quebec?
faqs.a: Local improvements usually begin within three to six months, and competitive terms in the largest cities take longer. Less saturated parts of Quebec often move faster because there is simply less competition.

faqs.q: Which cities in Quebec should I target first?
faqs.a: Start with the places you already serve and can describe distinctly, often around Montreal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau and Longueuil. Pages for areas you genuinely cover rank faster and convert better than a page that claims the whole province.
